title: The horizontal cone graded complex is a shifted column cone
statement: Let $C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] in which every natural-indexed first-quadrant bicomplex has a total complex [def-sp-double-complex-total]. Let $f:A\to B$ be a morphism of such bicomplexes, and let $M=\operatorname{Cone}(\operatorname{extend}(\operatorname{Tot}(f)))$. For $h\in\mathbb N$ and integer $m\ge0$, let $s_{K,h,m}$ be the total inclusion of $K^{h,m-h}$, followed by the inverse extension isomorphism into $(\operatorname{extend}\operatorname{Tot}(K))^m$, and put it equal to zero if $m<0$ or $h>m$. Let $J_{h,n}$ be the join of the images of $s_{A,h,n+1}$ followed by the source cone inclusion and $s_{B,h,n}$ followed by the target cone inclusion. Define $S_{p,n}$ to be the finite supremum of $J_{h,n}$ for natural $h<(n+2).toNat$ with $p\le h$. Let $F$ be a decreasing filtration by subcomplexes of $M$ [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients] such that $F.complexStep(p,n)=S_{p,n}$ for every integer $p,n$. For every integer $p\ge0$, there is a chain isomorphism $\operatorname{gr}_F^p M\cong\operatorname{Cone}(\operatorname{extend}(f^{p,\bullet}))[-p]$.

proof.text: Evaluation preserves cokernels. In degree n the quotient of the tail with indices at least p by the tail with indices at least p+1 is exactly the direct sum of the source term A^{p,n+1-p} and the target term B^{p,n-p}. Their diagonal inclusions give the quotient isomorphism; finite biproduct projections give its inverse. Terms with negative vertical index vanish by extension by zero. These statements also hold when both tails are zero.

source.place: First horizontal filtration, displayed formula preceding Lemma 12.25.1; columnwise mapping-cone refinement of parent node proof steps 1 and 3.

proof.text: The induced horizontal differential is zero in the quotient. Write e=(-1)^p. The three remaining blocks are -e*d_A, e*d_B and f. The column cone shifted by -p has the same diagonal blocks and off-diagonal block e*f. Multiply the source term by e, and keep the target term fixed. This commutes with both diagonal blocks and with the off-diagonal block because e²=1. The same factors give the inverse. The source at n=p-1 (vertical cone degree -1) must be included; below that degree both objects are zero.

lean.statement:
theorem coneHorizontal_graded_iso
    {A B : HomologicalComplex₂ C (ComplexShape.up ℕ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)}
    (f : A ⟶ B)
    (F : DecreasingFiltration (CochainComplex.mappingCone
      (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (total.map f (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
        ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)))
    (hF : ∀ p n : ℤ, F.complexStep p n = coneHorizontalStep f p n)
    (p : ℤ) (hp : 0 ≤ p) :
    Nonempty (F.gradedPiece p ≅
      (CochainComplex.mappingCone
        (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (f.f p.toNat) ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat))⟦-p⟧)
